title: Hiring IT specialists by measured skill

hero.title: Hiring that cannot be gamed
hero.lead: Candidates prove their level with an adaptive test and FSP achievements. Employers see skills with honest uncertainty and invite the right people themselves.
hero.candidate: I am looking for a job

test.title: The test measures your level
test.text: The adaptive test picks tasks based on your answers and stops once the uncertainty is small.

profile.title: The profile collects signals
profile.text: FSP, the verification block, the test, tasks and self-description carry different weight: the harder to fake, the more it counts.

invite.title: The employer invites
invite.text: The shortlist explains every place. An invitation comes with a salary range, and contacts open only after you agree.

candidate.title: For candidates
candidate.one: Your category comes from the test, not from keywords in a résumé.
candidate.two: A skill profile by topic: level with honest uncertainty.
candidate.three: Employers find you. Your contacts stay hidden until you agree.
candidate.sample: This is what a topic level looks like

employer.title: For employers
employer.one: Describe the need in plain words, and it is turned into topic requirements.
employer.two: The shortlist explains every place: topic contributions and trust sources.
employer.three: Invite with a salary range instead of sifting through blind applications.
employer.sample: This is what a match with your need looks like

fsp.title: FSP achievements count the most
fsp.text: Results of supervised in-person competitions cannot be generated. Link your FSP ID and they join your skill profile at the highest trust level.
fsp.note: No FSP history is fine too: your profile is built from the test with no penalty.

footer.made: A hiring service for FSP participants and partners
